about: Acoustic constants shared by the pipeline and the future site. Values from docs/acoustic_sanity_check.xlsx (2026-10-12).
band_index_note: Exact centre frequency = 1000 * 10^(0.3 * index), used for air absorption.
hearing_threshold_note: [unverified] recalled ISO 226:2003 free-field threshold for pure tones, used as an octave-band approximation
characters_source: Fiumicelli, Parker, Lawrence, Stewart: Low frequency sound at outdoor concerts (IOA), Table 1; octave bands, unweighted, normalised to 98 dB(A)
classes_note: [assumed] typical playing level LAeq at a distance from the stack; DIN 15905-5 audience limit and IOA mix-position data, not measured at outdoor parties
cardioid_note: [assumed] Subs crossed over below about 100 Hz; 10 dB rear rejection for those bands
targets_note: 35 dB(A): NV 272/2011 night limit, kept as a reference only. 47 dB: NRL 2016 guidance, clearly acceptable outdoors.
